body_markdown:
Would it be possible to add lazy edge swipes to the iPad app? similar to what Reeder Classic has.


Ever since Apple introduced windows mode for iPad OS, swiping back in the Newsblur app column auto mode when in portrait iPad orientation causes the Newsblur app window to resize. This has been especially bad in the iOS 27 beta release. The only way to go back to the feed list is to tap on the top left button, which is ok, but not ideal. So I thought if you guys could implement lazy edge swiping akin to what reeder iOS/iPad OS does, then it would solve the issue.


I much prefer to use the Newsblur app over the forgotten Reeder Classic app. I prefer the typography and additional features. But this is a annoying enough issue on the iPad, that i’ve gone back to using the other app.
